authority.facts_source: R4 stress-facts.json current nonzero anomaly records and R4 regression markers

claim_boundary: Source context is an evidence-bound lookup, not a root-cause, severity, or Product defect verdict.

ownership_legend.NiceGUI Base governed source candidate: Exact token was searched in current source; matches are listed without causal attribution.
ownership_legend.generated/library-internal: Observed runtime token is from Quasar/JSONEditor/Svelte/runtime-generated DOM vocabulary or a dynamic runtime id.
ownership_legend.runtime-observed selector: Observed selector retained for audit; exact current source ownership is not assumed.

packed_context_note: Lossless zlib+base64 encoding of every exact selector/class/data-attribute entry and its current-source matches, including likely owning files, symbols, short line ranges and scope. This is not a hash-only array.
